findings: Historical Gate E no-FP lite reached /init; B25 physical Linux platform is a separate integration gap.
Board CPU IRQ is tied low; existing GIC supports Timer PPI but needs an external UART SPI path.
Core Timer uses instruction-retirement/WFI virtual time and reports 1 GHz; real hardware counter mode is needed.
Board UART is Altera JTAG-UART, not historical Linux-lite PL011.
EPCQ CSR exists but the Flash memory read port is tied off and its declared 4 KiB placeholder is not routed.
Reference Flash scripts use absolute source offsets in descriptors and relative Intel HEX plus COF base.
Reference FLASH_IMAGE_NAME is printed but does not select the file actually opened; new tools must bind actual inputs.
Current board runner is volatile-only and T-053-specific exceptions cannot be reused as a Linux/Flash workflow.
known_limits: Only existing local sources and historical evidence were read; current GamePC availability and reference artifacts were not rechecked.
Proposed Flash aperture, payload base, kernel/DTB placement and UART SPI number are implementation defaults, not deployed interfaces.
Planning completion does not mark any Linux board boot or Flash milestone complete.
